notes.title: Patch Notes v5i
notes.notes:
Ahoy!

We've been doing a lot of behind the scenes improvements to the game; planning and prototyping over the past to find the next steps on where we're taking the game. We have some cool VFX improvements coming in the next week, so be on the lookout!

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Multithreading for collisions and AI systems are now implemented
    [*]Reduced memory leaks and better object pooling reducing garbage collection spikes
[/list]

[h1]Graphical Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Improved rope rendering when Anti-aliasing is turned on
    [*]Added wind to Spitting Dragon sails, other ships will have wind on soon.
[/list]

[h1]Misc Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Improved bot AI
    [*]Improvements & bug fixes to objective system
    [*]SFX improvements on cannon shots, death, and new waterfall SFX
    [*]Improved our database backend to make feature development easier
[/list]

Best,
Robert Dunlap
Extrokold Games

notes.title: Patch Notes for February 10th
notes.notes:
Ahoy! We got a bunch of stuff in this recent build geared towards improving pixel fillrate issues that were causing slow framerates on low-end PCs.

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Optimized LOD1 and LOD2 islands.
    [*]Redid trees to remove cutout shader.
    [*]Smaller texture sizes more texture atlases.
    [*]Islands have fewer draw calls to the GPU.
    [*]Simpler terrain shader for LOD1 and 2 islands.
[/list]

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
    [*]4 new islands; Colossus head, feet, and arm is now near the temple ruins.
    [*]More sharks!
    [*]Added in 8 new flags designed by Lacey Drake.
[/list]

[h1]Tweaks[/h1]
Improvements to colors and lighting on playerships and islands.

Best,
Robert Dunlap
Extrokold Games

notes.title: Patch Notes for 12/6/2016

Ahoy Mateys!

We've been listening to feedback that you've been providing during the playtesting, one of the biggest changes in this update is a rework on ship to ship collisions with Hull Upgrades & Iron Horn's ability no longer mitigating damage; this should make collisions when at low health more predictable in your ability to take the other ship with you.

[list]
    [*]Hulls no longer give ramming mitigation
    [*]Iron Horn's ram ability no longer mitigates damage; deals 100/200/300 additional impact damage
    [*]Iron Horn's passive is now the only ramming mitigation; still at 5/10/15
    [*]NPC ship base ramming [strike]100[/strike] -> 150; bonus impact [strike]200[/strike] -> 100
   [*]Flamethrower damage reduced by ~10%
   [*]Shipwreck heal amount increased to 75
   [*]Passive healing increased 1.5/2/2.5->2/3/4 improving on hull level
[/list]

[h1]Voice Over[/h1]
The first set of lines from Michael Malconian as our new pirate voice is in.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Water color adjustment
    [*]Fixed issues with recent collision detection changes
[/list]

Best,
Extrokold Games

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/6/2016
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've been working on an overhaul of the Menu UI as well as the addition of the Spitting Dragon, which should make its appearance next week! We have a bunch of changes that are in today's build as we work on getting everything integrated in, enjoy!

[b]Barrel Bomb Buffs[/b]
The other week we made some drastic nerfs to the Barrel Bomb, we're bringing it closer to what it origionally was at.

[list]
    [*]Barrel Bomb Cooldown: 22.5 -> 18.75 seconds
    [*]Barrel Bomb % Max HP Damage: 5/10/15 -> 7.5/12.5/17.5%
[/list]

[b]Iron Horns Tweaks[/b]
We found the Ram ability was really fun to use and that the extra mitigation didn't provide much of a reason to upgrade. Included is some improvements on its visuals.

[list]
    [*]Ram now has a cool particle animation effect
    [*]Iron Horns eyes now glow with the ships tertiary color, making it pop more.
    [*]Ram impact damage mitigation: 35/45/55% -> 35/40/45%
    [*]Ram cooldown: 120 seconds -> 160/120/80 seconds.
    [*]Death reduces an active cooldown by 60 seconds.
    [*]Upgrading Ability reduces an active cooldown by 40 seconds.
[/list]

[b]Custimization Menu Revamp WIP[/b]
[list]
    [*] Flags with varients now are collapsed
    [*] Achievement flags now have their own folder
    [*] Folders now use custom icons
    [*] New Country Flag folder icon (Achievement and Custom coming soon)
[/list]

[b]Ship textures are now lighter and coloring improvements[/b]


Happy Sailing!
Robert Dunlap

notes.notes:
Hey all!

We have some pretty drastic gameplay changes in today's build. We'll be monitoring them much so during playtesting this week and during Saturday's gameplay session; so please do join us in on that! Saturday 11am-2pm PDT!

[list]
    [*]On death [b]only[/b] the most recently purchased upgrade is now lost.
[/list]

When we changed the upgrade cost structure last month to be incremental based on total number of upgrades rather than level based we didn't have the right feel for staying relavent in the match after you've farmed so much. We hope this takes us in the right direction (expect costs and gold dropped in game to be tweaked further).


[list]
    [*]Starting Gold: 300 -> 350
    [*]Upgrade Cost: 200/400/600/800/../1600 -> 250/500/750/1000/../2000
    [*]If you have more than Starting Gold on hand when you die, you'll keep that amount rather then being reset to Starting Gold.
    [*] Fixed error due to drawing player names at the start of matches before initialized
[/list]

Best,
Robert Dunlap

notes.title: Patch Note Round Up 8/22-8/28/2016
notes.notes:
Here is the weekly round up of the patch notes from the last week (The week of 8/22 to 8/28/2016)

The new ship the Ghastly Crow was added.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11695195/1ca60f9253b540436fa9947060d3ae63fa5904a7.jpg[/img]

The Ghastly Crow has a Poison Gas ability that replaces the Barrel Bomb, it costs gold while its on and any enemies caught in its cloud take damage. While on you get a small speed buff after its been upgraded and on death your ship deploys a large cloud to take out your close ranged killer.


Now for the changes then the fixes of the week:


Changes: 
Barrel Bomb level 0 added so it can be used from the start. However it does half damage and has a reduced blast radius compared to level 1.
Level 2 has been given an increased radius and does an extra 50 damage.

The new stats are: 

Flat Damage: 50/100/150 
% Max Health Damage: 5/10/20 
Radius: 8/12.5/15 
Cooldown: 15/15/15 second 
Cost to fire: 50/50/50 

The old: 

Flat Damage: 100/100 
% Max Health Damage: 10/20 
Radius: 12.5/12.5 
Cooldown: 15/15 seconds 
Cost to fire: 50/50 


Fixes:
Various fixes were added for the new ship that was found during our various playtests. Such as the fix for the glow on the front of the ship and to have it leave a bit of it's smoke ability where it dies.
Various fixes were added to the smoke ability such as it not triggering after being turned off on it's first use.

Fix on Hull Upgrades not registering after Ghastly Crow was added in.

Fix on Cannon ball collisions not registering properly after optimization pass.

As a warning soon a version check will be added to the lobby so you will only see matches that match your verison number. So make sure to stay updated. 


Well that's it for this weeks roundup. I hope everyone is continuing to enjoy the game and we look forward to seeing you on the High Seas!
